build_assigner: build a bounding box assigner from a config dict using the BBOX_ASSIGNERS registry
build_sampler: build a bounding box sampler from a config dict using the BBOX_SAMPLERS registry
build_bbox_coder: build a bounding box coder from a config dict using the BBOX_CODERS registry
review_BBOX_ASSIGNERS: review the BBOX_ASSIGNERS registry to list all registered bounding box assigner types
review_BBOX_SAMPLERS: review the BBOX_SAMPLERS registry to list all registered bounding box sampler types
